mission.title: Continuous cognitive production / geometric useful growth

rationale: Per-chat yield still has a 10/10 observed leader, but the scoreboard has no independently reproduced non-null YIELD-10X-V1 champion.

TKV1's planner suppression remains intact, and this Guide cycle found a second SOURCE_DEBT waste path: the stale recovery lane offered G000002 for the José NEW_EVIDENCE_GATE job even though its contract forbids time-only reopening.

A semantic fixed-generation recovery policy now freezes that gate job at G000001; the public claim frontier regenerated from the repair commit and no longer exposes the José G000002 recovery candidate.
Runtime occupancy evidence remains older than the frontier, so a numeric launch recommendation is still unjustified.
External wake remains unproven; a fresh /wc invocation is still the known wake mechanism.

axes.question: How much independently useful work is truly active, not merely launched?
How much evidence-backed useful work does each launched chat produce?
Does completed work create grounded successors/assist work faster than it consumes frontier?
How much output reaches user/project-visible value instead of control-plane churn?
How much human intervention is still required to wake, route, merge or remember?

experiments.hypothesis: The 10/10 leader shape can be reproduced by independent workers using post-ownership scheduling guidance without altering claim-first.
experiments.pass: At least 3 independent workers with pattern_id=YIELD-10X-V1 score >=8/10.
experiments.fail: Pattern-tagged workers repeatedly underperform; inspect causal dimensions and revise/reject candidate.

experiments.hypothesis: Exact post-claim file/test/non-goal packets can increase useful units per chat by reducing archaeology.
minimal_file_plan: extend allocator/job candidate post-claim context shape
measure time/reads/productive slots versus current pattern workers
experiments.activation_gate: Only if pattern reproduction evidence still shows material post-claim context/search waste.

experiments.hypothesis: Different post-ownership strategies may dominate for different job classes; tagged A/B patterns can discover this faster than one universal heuristic.
minimal_file_plan: pattern registry or second candidate only after first reproduction sample exists
experiments.activation_gate: Need enough v3.27 pattern-tagged exams to avoid premature branching.

creative_levers.mechanism: Extract high-yield worker behavior into a tagged post-ownership candidate pattern and reproduce/falsify it independently.
Compile post-claim job packets with exact target files, relevant refs, expected tests and explicit non-goals so workers spend fewer tokens/time rediscovering context.
Route browser/network/physical/tool-specific jobs only toward runtimes that can actually execute them; use generic workers for repository-native work.
When a productive worker approaches context/runtime limits, emit one bounded continuation packet/derived job so another worker resumes exact unfinished work without archaeology.
Run multiple tagged post-ownership scheduling patterns concurrently and compare evidence-backed exam distributions instead of guessing one universal behavior.
When two jobs are similarly grounded, prefer the one more likely to produce user-visible product value while keeping authority and project balance intact.
Measure whether workers leave enough grounded successors to prevent useful frontier starvation without manufacturing filler.
Separate chat-launch limitation from allocator autonomy; design a proven launcher/runtime only if the product supports one, never fake background execution.

trajectory.strongest_evidence: One 10/10 six-slot worker demonstrates high yield is possible; Guide continuity/quality is now verified.
trajectory.weakest_evidence: No independent pattern-tagged reproduction yet; current occupancy is unknown from stale runtime; external wake remains unproven.
